title.fr: Que faire en cas de *saignement grave*

caption.en: Heavy bleeding? Act fast. Here's what to do.
caption.es: ¿Sangrado abundante? Actúa rápido. Esto es lo que debes hacer.
caption.fr: Un saignement important ? Agis vite. Voici les bons gestes.
caption.ja: 大量の出血？ すばやく対応しましょう。手順を見ていきます。

scenes.svg: <path class='d' data-s='0' data-d='0.6' fill='none' stroke='#1d1d1d' stroke-width='10' d='M 200 880 H 700 M 200 960 H 700'/><circle class='d' data-s='0.5' data-d='0.4' cx='760' cy='920' r='60' fill='none' stroke='#1d1d1d' stroke-width='9'/><path class='d' data-s='0.9' data-d='0.5' fill='none' stroke='#e63946' stroke-width='10' d='M 430 880 q 20 40 0 80 M 470 880 q 20 40 0 80'/><path class='d' data-s='1.3' data-d='0.5' fill='none' stroke='#e63946' stroke-width='9' d='M 450 960 q -10 40 0 70 M 450 1050 q -8 20 0 35'/>

caption.en: *1* — Call *emergency services* right away, or ask someone nearby to call.
caption.es: *1* — *Llama a emergencias* de inmediato, o pide a alguien cercano que llame.
caption.fr: *1* — *Appelle les urgences* tout de suite, ou demande à quelqu'un de le faire.
caption.ja: *1* — すぐに*救急車*を呼びます。近くの人に頼んでもかまいません。

scenes.svg: <path class='d' data-s='0' data-d='0.6' fill='none' stroke='#e63946' stroke-width='11' d='M 430 640 H 650 V 1000 H 430 Z M 520 960 H 560'/><path class='d' data-s='0.8' data-d='0.5' fill='none' stroke='#e63946' stroke-width='9' d='M 800 700 q 40 40 0 80 M 850 670 q 70 70 0 140'/>

caption.en: *2* — Press *hard and firmly* on the wound with a clean cloth or gauze. Use your hands.
caption.es: *2* — *Presiona fuerte y sin soltar* la herida con un paño limpio o gasa. Usa tus manos.
caption.fr: *2* — *Appuie fort et sans relâcher* sur la plaie avec un linge propre ou une compresse.
caption.ja: *2* — 清潔な布やガーゼで傷を*強く*しっかり押さえます。手で押さえましょう。

scenes.svg: <path class='d' data-s='0' data-d='0.6' fill='none' stroke='#1d1d1d' stroke-width='10' d='M 200 880 H 700 M 200 960 H 700'/><circle class='d' data-s='0.5' data-d='0.4' cx='760' cy='920' r='60' fill='none' stroke='#1d1d1d' stroke-width='9'/><path class='d' data-s='0.9' data-d='0.5' fill='none' stroke='#e63946' stroke-width='10' d='M 430 880 q 20 40 0 80 M 470 880 q 20 40 0 80'/><path class='d' data-s='1.3' data-d='0.5' fill='none' stroke='#e63946' stroke-width='9' d='M 450 960 q -10 40 0 70 M 450 1050 q -8 20 0 35'/><path class='d' data-s='0' data-d='0.7' fill='none' stroke='#3a86c8' stroke-width='11' d='M 380 850 H 520 V 990 H 380 Z'/><path class='f' data-s='0.6' data-d='0.5' data-o='0.3' d='M 380 850 H 520 V 990 H 380 Z' fill='#3a86c8' opacity='0'/><path class='d' data-s='1.0' data-d='0.7' fill='none' stroke='#1d1d1d' stroke-width='10' d='M 450 700 L 450 840 M 400 740 L 450 700 L 500 740'/>

caption.en: *3* — Keep pressing without peeking. If blood soaks through, add more cloth on top.
caption.es: *3* — Sigue presionando sin mirar. Si la sangre empapa el paño, añade más encima.
caption.fr: *3* — Continue d'appuyer sans regarder. Si le sang traverse, ajoute un autre linge par-dessus.
caption.ja: *3* — のぞかずに押さえ続けます。血がしみたら、上から布を重ねます。

scenes.svg: <path class='d' data-s='0' data-d='0.6' fill='none' stroke='#1d1d1d' stroke-width='10' d='M 200 880 H 700 M 200 960 H 700'/><circle class='d' data-s='0.5' data-d='0.4' cx='760' cy='920' r='60' fill='none' stroke='#1d1d1d' stroke-width='9'/><path class='d' data-s='0.9' data-d='0.5' fill='none' stroke='#e63946' stroke-width='10' d='M 430 880 q 20 40 0 80 M 470 880 q 20 40 0 80'/><path class='d' data-s='1.3' data-d='0.5' fill='none' stroke='#e63946' stroke-width='9' d='M 450 960 q -10 40 0 70 M 450 1050 q -8 20 0 35'/><path class='d' data-s='0' data-d='0.7' fill='none' stroke='#3a86c8' stroke-width='11' d='M 380 850 H 520 V 990 H 380 Z'/><path class='f' data-s='0.6' data-d='0.5' data-o='0.3' d='M 380 850 H 520 V 990 H 380 Z' fill='#3a86c8' opacity='0'/><path class='d' data-s='0.8' data-d='0.5' fill='none' stroke='#888' stroke-width='10' d='M 360 800 H 540 V 850 H 360 Z'/><path class='d' data-s='1.0' data-d='0.7' fill='none' stroke='#1d1d1d' stroke-width='10' d='M 450 700 L 450 840 M 400 740 L 450 700 L 500 740'/>

caption.en: If you can, have them *lie down* and raise the injured limb. Don't remove the first cloth.
caption.es: Si puedes, haz que se *acueste* y eleva la extremidad herida. No retires el primer paño.
caption.fr: Si possible, fais-le *s'allonger* et surélève le membre blessé. N'enlève pas le premier linge.
caption.ja: できれば*横にして*、けがをした手足を高くします。最初の布ははがしません。

scenes.svg: <path class='d' data-s='0' data-d='0.6' fill='none' stroke='#1d1d1d' stroke-width='10' d='M 200 880 H 700 M 200 960 H 700'/><circle class='d' data-s='0.5' data-d='0.4' cx='760' cy='920' r='60' fill='none' stroke='#1d1d1d' stroke-width='9'/><path class='d' data-s='0' data-d='0.7' fill='none' stroke='#3a86c8' stroke-width='11' d='M 380 850 H 520 V 990 H 380 Z'/><path class='f' data-s='0.6' data-d='0.5' data-o='0.3' d='M 380 850 H 520 V 990 H 380 Z' fill='#3a86c8' opacity='0'/><path class='d' data-s='1.0' data-d='0.5' fill='none' stroke='#3a86c8' stroke-width='9' d='M 800 960 L 880 840'/>

caption.en: Don't pull out *objects* stuck in the wound. Press around them. Stay with the person until help arrives.
caption.es: No saques *objetos* clavados en la herida. Presiona alrededor. Quédate con la persona hasta que llegue la ayuda.
caption.fr: Ne retire pas un *objet* planté dans la plaie. Appuie autour. Reste avec la personne jusqu'aux secours.
caption.ja: 傷に刺さった*物*は抜かず、まわりを押さえます。助けが来るまでそばにいましょう。

scenes.svg: <path class='d' data-s='0' data-d='0.6' fill='none' stroke='#1d1d1d' stroke-width='10' d='M 300 800 H 780 M 300 960 H 780'/><path class='d' data-s='0.7' data-d='0.5' fill='none' stroke='#e63946' stroke-width='14' d='M 540 640 V 900'/><path class='d' data-s='1.3' data-d='0.5' fill='none' stroke='#e63946' stroke-width='16' d='M 330 600 L 750 1000 M 750 600 L 330 1000'/>

caption.en: Get *medical help* for any wound that bleeds heavily, spurts, or won't stop after 10 minutes of pressure.
caption.es: Busca *atención médica* si una herida sangra mucho, sale a chorros o no para tras 10 minutos de presión.
caption.fr: Cherche une *aide médicale* si une plaie saigne beaucoup, gicle ou ne s'arrête pas après 10 minutes de pression.
caption.ja: 大量に出る、噴き出す、10分押さえても止まらない出血は*医療機関*へ。
